item.title: mdcx: verified conversion of document collections to queryable Markdown
item.description:
Jorge Ellena
Converts complete document collections to Markdown, checking each file against the text the original actually exposes, packages the resulting corpus with its index and provenance into a single encrypted file, and exposes it to agents through the Model Context Protocol. Over a collection of 99 documents, answering one query through the package costs 435 model tokens against the 2,265,488 required to read the originals.
